name: make_uppercase_unterminated_string

name: clear_free_doublefree

name: next_item_unterminated_scan

name: bio_to_mem_growth_bug

name: app_passwd_null_outptrs

name: wrap_password_callback_overflow

name: name_cmp_null_deref

name: print_array_len_trust_oob
